g.text: by eye; folding 42 transits gives ≈ √42 gain.
Simulation: 730 days at 30-min cadence with gaps; starspot modulation (25-day rotation, ~0.6 ppt), white noise 250 ppm per point; limb-darkened transit of a 1.3 R⊕
planet on a Sun-like star. Detrending by a 2-day running median; BLS with seven box durations and 800 phase bins per trial period. Seed 51.
